caption: The drawing depicts a single blue-tinted glass goblet centered on a plain, light beige background. The goblet features a wide, flared rim with horizontal lines suggesting transparency and thickness, tapering down to a rounded, textured bowl with an embossed swirl pattern around its circumference. The bowl sits atop a short, stemmed base that expands into a broad, flat foot. The entire drawing is enclosed within a rectangular border, and the artist's name, "JOHN DANA," appears in small capital letters at the lower left corner inside the border. The object is rendered in shades of blue with subtle variations for shading and highlights to suggest its glass material and three-dimensional form.
title: Vase
